title: Unseen Parchment
body:
By installing this mod, it adds an item to the creative inventory called the "Unseen Parchment". While it is anywhere in your inventory, you become fully invisible to anyone unless you are near the side of their screen.

If you get any advancements with the item, it will not appear in chat.

Any kills you get will make your name obfuscated to hide your identity.

Depending on your mod version, you will become invincible. (Not the v-1 no invincibility versions)

By being 'fully invisible', it hides your nametag, shadow, effect particles, footsteps, and makes your footsteps silent.
